The site named above was audited against the BRCGS Global Standard for Food Safety, Issue 9, and was found to conform at the grade shown. The certificate is issued by SGS North America Inc. under accreditation held with ANSI National Accreditation Board to ISO/IEC 17065, and remains the property of the issuing office.

Validity is conditional on the site notifying the certification body of any change affecting the scope, on closure of the non-conformities recorded at the audit within the periods allowed by the standard, and on the re-audit taking place inside the window opening on the date shown. Verification of the certificate's status may be obtained from the BRCGS Directory.
